# MatchStamp { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp }

```python
alignment.MatchStamp(
    coordinates=dict(),
    anchor_edges=list(),
    inferred_edges=list(),
    units=dict(),
    axis=None,
    source=None,
    source_id=None,
    is_interpolated=False,
    conversion_maps=False,
)
```

A synchronized timestamp across multiple timelines.

A MatchStamp represents a single coordinate (or instant) that has been
synchronized across multiple timelines via explicit anchors and/or
inferred group membership.

Contains one coordinate per participating timeline, where coordinates
are linked via explicit anchors or inferred group membership.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name            | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                          |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinates     | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [float](`float`)\]                      | Dict of timeline_id -> coordinate.                                                   |
| anchor_edges    | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\]\]      | List of (tl_a, tl_b) pairs that are explicitly anchored.                             |
| inferred_edges  | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\]\]      | List of (tl_a, tl_b) pairs inferred via groups.                                      |
| units           | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\]                          | Coordinate unit name for each timeline.                                              |
| axis            | [float](`float`) \| None                                              | Coordinate used to query the stamp.                                                  |
| source          | \'AlignmentBundle \| None\'                                           | Bundle that produced the stamp.                                                      |
| source_id       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Timeline ID used for the query.                                                      |
| is_interpolated | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | Whether the stamp used interpolated transfer.                                        |
| conversion_maps | [ConversionMapsSpec](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.ConversionMapsSpec`) | Conversion maps available to unit lookup and display. Opt-in: defaults to ``False``. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> stamp = MatchStamp(
...     coordinates={"score": 100.0, "audio": 45.5, "video": 1365.0},
...     anchor_edges=[("score", "audio")],
...     inferred_edges=[("audio", "video")],
... )
>>> stamp.get("audio")
45.5
```


Create filtered stamp with subset of timelines.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

|--------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|-----------|
| timeline_ids | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | Only include these timelines (None = all). | `None`    |
| id_pattern   | [str](`str`) \| None                 | Regex filter for timeline IDs.             | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                             |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchStamp\' | New MatchStamp with filtered timelines. |

### get { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp.get }

```python

```

| Name        | Type                     | Description                                 | Default    |
|-------------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`)             | The timeline to get coordinate for.         | _required_ |
| default     | [float](`float`) \| None | Value returned when the timeline is absent. | `None`     |

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                               |
|--------|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [float](`float`) \| None | The coordinate, or the default if the timeline is absent. |

### get_unit { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp.get_unit }

```python
alignment.MatchStamp.get_unit(unit)
```

Get the query coordinate converted to a unit.

Unit conversion is delegated to the source timeline's owning group so
the same conversion-map selection rules as ``TimeStamp`` apply.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                          | Description      | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------|------------------|------------|
| unit   | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) | The target unit. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                                   |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [float](`float`) \| None | The converted coordinate, or None when it cannot be resolved. |

### has_timeline { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp.has_timeline }

```python
alignment.MatchStamp.has_timeline(timeline_id)
```

Check if timeline is in this stamp.

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                              |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The requested dictionary representation. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                            |
